iWant: to record PASS or FAIL for the reviewed head from the TAP summary of the full RCF suite
soThat: the TEST pass is a branch commit that names the code it tested
description: rcf build verdict test and TestVerdict v1.
title: A verifier records the TEST verdict from the full RCF suite run against a locally running app

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture branch whose HEAD is a REVIEW: commit adding a MERGE/PASS review.json for H, and a TAP file from node --test whose summary reads 12 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip, 0 todo and which includes every bound test of the touched criteria, when rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS --tap <file> --runtime "fixture app on localhost:8787" runs, then it exits 0, stdout is "verdict: test PASS at <H7> (12 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip, 0 todo) written to rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json", and the file parses as TestVerdict v1 with head the full sha of H and node equal to the running Node version.

[failure] Given the same branch and a TAP summary with 2 failing tests, --result PASS exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: the TAP summary reports 2 failing; record --result FAIL"; given a TAP file lacking the bound test of AC-101-2, --result PASS exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: the TAP summary does not include bound test <pointer> of AC-101-2"; given a file with no TAP summary it exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --tap <file> carries no TAP summary"; no test.json is written in any case.

[failure] Given a branch whose newest review.json for H records code FINDINGS, or none at all, --result PASS exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: no REVIEW MERGE with adequacy PASS recorded for <H7>"; given a later "BUILD: fix" commit that changed src/x.js after H, it exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: HEAD differs from the reviewed head <H7> outside rcf/verdicts/, rcf/verify-reports/ and FINALISE classes".

[edge] Given a branch whose rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json already records PASS, a second rcf build verdict test for the same head exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: a test verdict for <H7> already exists at rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json" and the file is byte-identical afterwards; given no test verdict yet, --result FAIL --reason "the suite hangs on the packed head" with a TAP summary of 0 failing writes result "FAIL" with that reason, and FAIL with 0 failing and no --reason exits 2; the one-verdict rule is per head, so a FAIL recorded after the PASS at H names HEAD and is not refused (stage-keeper ruling 3).

[must-not] rcf build verdict test never runs the suite itself, never deploys or contacts a host, never writes outside rcf/verdicts/<H12>/ and never commits: a spawn seam records only git, and git status --porcelain after a run lists at most the one new file.

[edge] Given a fixture branch REVIEW: (MERGE/PASS for H), TEST: (PASS at H) and "FINALISE: merge main" (a clean merge) at head M, when rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result FAIL --tap <a TAP file with 1 failing> --runtime "fixture app" runs, then it exits 0, stdout is "verdict: test FAIL at <M7> (0 pass, 1 fail, 0 skip, 0 todo) written to rcf/verdicts/<M12>/test.json", that file's head is the full sha of M, and rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json is byte-identical; the same with --result PASS at M exits 4 with "verdict refused: a test verdict for <H7> already exists at rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json".

[failure] Given a fixture at H whose rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json records result fail for AC-101-2 and a TAP summary of 0 failing, rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS exits 4 with stderr "verdict refused: test-strength at <H7> fails for AC-101-2; record --result FAIL" and writes nothing; --result FAIL --reason "test strength fails" writes result FAIL; with no test-strength record at H, PASS is not refused for that reason.

[failure] Given a review.json for H with fbsIds ["FBS-001", "FBS-002"], rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --fbs FBS-001 differs from the REVIEW verdict's fbsIds FBS-001,FBS-002" and writes nothing; with --fbs FBS-002,FBS-001 it writes the verdict; given --by omitted, the review verdict's recordedBy reads "reviewer" and the test verdict's "verifier".

[failure] Given a fixture project that is not a git repository, rcf build verdict review --fbs FBS-001 --acs AC-101-1 --code MERGE --adequacy PASS and rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS --tap <a readable TAP file> --runtime <text> each exit 4 with stderr "verdict refused: not a git repository; a verdict names a committed head"; given a git fixture, rcf build verdict test with --tap naming a file that does not exist exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --tap <file> cannot be read"; in each case no file appears under rcf/verdicts/.

[edge] Given a fixture branch whose HEAD is a REVIEW: commit adding a MERGE/PASS review.json for H, an untracked report file under rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/ and a TAP file passing every bound test of the touched criteria, when rcf build verdict test --fbs FBS-001 --result PASS --tap <file> --runtime <text> runs, then it exits 0 and writes rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json: the verdict verb's dirty check ignores untracked files under rcf/verify-reports/; and given an untracked rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test.json and no other change, rcf verify run --hand verifier --fbs FBS-001 --url <loopback> --engine <name> --served-sha <HEAD> does not refuse with "verify report refused: working tree is dirty; the report must name a committed head", and neither does rcf verify run --package . --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier: the verify runner's dirty check ignores rcf/verdicts/ in every rcf verify run mode, --url, --package and --artefact alike; an uncommitted change to src/x.js still refuses each verb as dirty with exit 4, under --package before packing; and the FBS-219 rules hold under --artefact: given the same change to src/x.js, rcf verify run --artefact <tgz> --fbs FBS-001 --hand verifier refuses exit 4 with stderr "verify report refused: working tree is dirty; the report must name a committed head" and writes no report, and --fbs absent or given twice exits 2.
